# Preparation acceptance fixtures

The fixtures contain fictional values specified by hand from the
[preparation format](../../../docs/reference/preparation-format.md),
[record decision](../../../docs/decisions/0090-plan-and-onboarding-record.md),
and [command decision](../../../docs/decisions/0220-preparation-command.md).

| Fixture | Independent purpose |
| -- | -- |
| plan.yaml | Identified plan with declared helpers, team, disabled section, and unanswered suggested required variable |
| preparation.yaml | Complete arrangement with recipient facts and retained root extension |
| record.yaml | Deferred progress and private answers that preparation edits must preserve |

Contract fixtures pin the complete show key set. Binary scenarios pin ownership
across accounts, clearing, preserved record bytes, and refusal boundaries.
